annotations.title: List or call the team's own tools

description: This team's own tools: the APIs and MCP servers the team added on ahel.ai under Your own tools. Without tool, lists each one with its tools, their inputs and the exact call. With tool ("<key>/<tool name>" from that list) and arguments, calls it with the team's saved credentials, which never enter the chat. NOT for: Ahel's catalog of data tasks and provider tools, which is capability_search. If the transport times out, do not resubmit the work: call again with the same ids and poll.

arguments.description: With tool: the tool's arguments, matching the inputs the list shows.

tool.description: Optional: "<key>/<tool name>" from the list, to call that tool. Omit to list the team's own tools.

name: my_tools
